newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on speculative selling.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell on Thursday on speculative selling at higher prices, traders said.
Lower export enquiries and increased new crop arrivals also led to some profit-taking by bull operators, they said.

Castorseed March delivery slid to 1,182/1,183 rupees per quintal from 1,186/1,187 rupees, they said. Arrivals of castorseed in the western Indian Gujarat region were 20/22 thousand bags (75 Kg each) on Thursday, they said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 342/344 rupees per 10 Kg on limited arrivals of 60/70 tonnes.
In Rajkot, spot oil was steady at Rs 520/525 per 15 Kg.
